The Secrets of Revelation — the first complete Surah revealed at one time.

The Manner of Supplication: Allah has taught mankind a comprehensive and complete prayer. It opens with His praise, followed by acknowledgement of His greatness and of the servant's servitude and worthlessness, to promise complete submission to Him, and finally to submit the request. It is fitting that this same manner be adopted for supplication: first the praise of Allah, then one's own admission of helplessness, a pledge of servitude, and then one's need.

All Praise is for Allah Alone, Rabb of the entire Universe: After seeking Allah's protection against Satan, and beginning in His Name, the first thing is to acknowledge that Allah is the centre of all excellence and every positive attribute. Be it beauty or glory, strength or might, knowledge or skill — whenever any quality is appreciated in the creation, the real credit always goes to the Creator. By appreciating a piece of art one in fact praises the artist. Allah is the Nourisher of the universe, the Bestower of skill and excellence upon the whole of creation; His system of Providence is so comprehensive that the entire creation benefits from it at once.
